To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
selenium is effective for preventing cancer in animals and humans.

selenium supplementation in humans reduces the risk of cancer, especially of the prostate, and that the mechanism by which selenium exerts its anticancer effects is by inducing the production of the antioxidant glutathione peroxidase (GPx), which is an important defense against oxidative stress and DNA damage (Figure 1).

the selenium status of the population is low, that low levels of serum selenium are associated with a high cancer mortality, and that selenium supplements are effective in reducing the risk of developing cancer.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification of the mechanisms by which selenium compounds prevent cancer, the development of selenium-containing compounds that are more effective than the naturally occurring compounds, and the development of a safe and effective selenium-containing chemoprevention agent for human use.
identifying the molecular mechanisms of action and the clinical implications of selenium in cancer prevention.
the role of selenium in cancer prevention.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the evidence for selenium's anticancer properties is promising but not definitive.
there is a strong rationale to support selenium's role in cancer prevention and treatment.
the evidence is insufficient to support a recommendation for the use of selenium in cancer prevention.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the evidence supports a beneficial effect of selenium on cancer prevention and that the effect appears to be most prominent for prostate and colorectal cancers.
selenium is not an effective agent for cancer prevention.
the selenium status of a person can be a significant factor in the development and/or progression of cancer, but that it is only one factor among a myriad of other factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
selenium is a very important nutrient in cancer prevention.
selenium is a safe and effective way to reduce the risk of cancer.
selenium may be a useful chemopreventive agent in the fight against cancer.
